summary: Continuation pass: covered the remaining gaps in factory.ts, TodoList.tsx, TodosPage.tsx and todos.ts. One guard in DeleteTodoDialog.tsx cannot be reached by a unit test.

decisions.reason: Separate file because it needs a file-scope router mock; covers the headers-already-sent branch of the error handler (line 20).
Separate file because it needs a TodoItem stub that exposes the handlers; checks that toggle, edit and delete receive the clicked task and busy is passed down.
Added a test for a query with no data, which is treated as an empty list (line 18 branch).
Added due-date sort tests with undated tasks on either side of the comparison (line 52 branch).
Line 19 (if (pending) return) is a defensive guard; every control that calls remove() is disabled while pending, so no UI interaction reaches it.

noFailingTest.detail: The guard is unreachable through the rendered UI because the delete button is disabled while pending.
